requirements.requirement: Matched-normal alignment and calibrated record preservation
Sample identity, contamination and scoped normal callability
All 17 original mutations reassessed independently of rediscovery
Independent primary-nuclear paired calling and native/population filtering
Fresh RNA, class-I affinity ranking and personal-normal self search
Integrated selection, joint assembly, junction/hydropathy and nucleotide checks
Every-antigen evidence review, methods and reproducible comparison

scientific_limitations: RNA counts may be sparse; gene-expression calibration unresolved
Normal self search is bounded, not proof of healthy-tissue absence
Recorded RNA-source translation, extra-base and strand uncertainties remain
In-frame driver region explicitly included above 500 nM
Residual junction binders remain; no cleavage/presentation/immunogenicity validation
Folding heuristic 21 versus target 14; hard sequence checks pass
PolyA/downstream extension unspecified; no complete molecular sequence
Instrument unknown; compatible analysis reference lacks original vendor masks
